            为什么你的TypeScript项目里，总会有几个.d.ts文件？
            <!----> <!----></h1> <div class="author-info-block block-hidden" data-v-61fb5e44=""><div class="author-info-box" data-v-61fb5e44=""><div class="author-name" data-v-61fb5e44=""><a href="/user/3507878440995946/posts" target="_blank" rel="" class="jj-link username username ellipsis" data-v-65b50b51="" data-v-292f6e48="" data-v-61fb5e44=""><span class="name" style="max-width:160px;" data-v-65b50b51="" data-v-292f6e48="">

                    阅读3分钟
                  </span> <!----></div></div> <div style="flex:1;" data-v-61fb5e44=""></div> <!----> <!----></div> <!----> <!----> <!----> <!----> <div id="article-root" itemprop="articleBody" class="main" data-v-61fb5e44=""><div class="article-viewer markdown-body result"><p>刚写TS那会儿，我看到项目里莫名其妙冒出个<code>types.d.ts</code>或者<code>global.d.ts</code>，心里是有点懵的。啥？这文件是干啥的？我 <code>.ts</code>文件不是已经写类型了吗？为啥还要多此一举？</p>
<p>后来，项目越做越大，第三方库用得越来越多，加上团队里有人用JS、有人用TS，我才发现——<strong><code>.d.ts</code> 文件，其实是个“救火队员”</strong>。</p>
<p><img src="https://p9-xtjj-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-73owjymdk6/07d7e7b796d8403b8ccf915e4626c820~tplv-73owjymdk6-jj-mark-v1:0:0:0:0:5o6Y6YeR5oqA5pyv56S-5Yy6IEAg5YiY5aSn5Y2O:q75.awebp?rk3s=f64ab15b&amp;x-expires=1764708962&amp;x-signature=vmM8Xx%2FjHp6dn5B7WXcrF0KDveg%3D" alt="" loading="lazy"></p>
<h3 data-id="heading-0">一、啥时候你会突然需要 <code>.d.ts</code>？</h3>
<p>先说个场景。</p>
<p>我们团队之前接入了一个老系统，人家封装了个JS工具库，叫<code>legacy-utils.js</code>，里面一堆函数：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-js" lang="js"><span class="hljs-comment">// legacy-utils.js</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">function</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">formatDate</span>(<span class="hljs-params">date</span>) {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> date.<span class="hljs-title function_">toISOString</span>().<span class="hljs-title function_">slice</span>(<span class="hljs-number">0</span>, <span class="hljs-number">10</span>);
}

<span class="hljs-keyword">function</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">calculateTax</span>(<span class="hljs-params">amount, rate</span>) {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> amount * rate * <span class="hljs-number">0.01</span>;
}
</code></pre>
<p>我们在TS项目里直接 import：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-ts" lang="ts"><span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> { formatDate } <span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> <span class="hljs-string">'./legacy-utils'</span>;

<span class="hljs-title function_">formatDate</span>(<span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">Date</span>()); <span class="hljs-comment">// 报错：Could not find a declaration file...</span>
</code></pre>
<p><strong>红了！</strong> VSCode一下就给你标红，说“这玩意没类型，我没法检查”。</p>
<p>这时候，你有两个选择：</p>
<ol>
<li>改人家JS文件，变成<code>.ts</code> —— 别想，那是别的团队维护的。</li>
<li>写个<code>.d.ts</code>文件，告诉TypeScript：“别慌，我知道它有啥类型。”</li>
</ol>
<p>于是，我默默在项目里建了个<code>types/legacy-utils.d.ts</code>：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-ts" lang="ts"><span class="hljs-comment">// types/legacy-utils.d.ts</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">declare</span> <span class="hljs-variable language_">module</span> <span class="hljs-string">'legacy-utils'</span> {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">export</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">function</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">formatDate</span>(<span class="hljs-params">date: <span class="hljs-built_in">Date</span></span>): <span class="hljs-built_in">string</span>;
  <span class="hljs-keyword">export</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">function</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">calculateTax</span>(<span class="hljs-params">amount: <span class="hljs-built_in">number</span>, rate: <span class="hljs-built_in">number</span></span>): <span class="hljs-built_in">number</span>;
}
</code></pre>
<p>然后，在<code>tsconfig.json</code>里确保<code>typeRoots</code>包含了<code>types</code>目录。</p>
<p>再回到代码里，红波浪线没了，自动补全也有了，世界清净了。</p>
<blockquote>
<p><strong>那一刻我悟了：<code>.d.ts</code> 就是给JS打“类型补丁”的。</strong></p>
</blockquote>
<h3 data-id="heading-1">二、还有啥场景会用到它？</h3>
<h4 data-id="heading-2">场景1：全局变量？别慌，<code>.d.ts</code>来兜底</h4>
<p>有些老项目，喜欢把变量挂到<code>window</code>上：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-js" lang="js"><span class="hljs-comment">// index.html</span>
&lt;script&gt;
  <span class="hljs-variable language_">window</span>.<span class="hljs-property">APP_CONFIG</span> = { <span class="hljs-attr">apiUrl</span>: <span class="hljs-string">'https://api.example.com'</span> };
&lt;/script&gt;
</code></pre>
<p>你在 TS 里写：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-ts" lang="ts"><span class="hljs-variable language_">console</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">log</span>(<span class="hljs-variable language_">window</span>.<span class="hljs-property">APP_CONFIG</span>.<span class="hljs-property">apiUrl</span>); <span class="hljs-comment">// 类型“Window &amp; typeof globalThis”上不存在属性“APP_CONFIG”</span>
</code></pre>
<p>烦不烦？烦。</p>
<p>解决方法：建个<code>global.d.ts</code>：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-ts" lang="ts"><span class="hljs-comment">// global.d.ts</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">interface</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">Window</span> {
  <span class="hljs-attr">APP_CONFIG</span>: {
    <span class="hljs-attr">apiUrl</span>: <span class="hljs-built_in">string</span>;
  };
}
</code></pre>
<p>保存，刷新，红波浪线消失。<strong>舒服了。</strong></p>
<blockquote>
<p>我管这个叫“强行扩展”，虽然有点野路子，但项目要上线，谁还管你是不是优雅。</p>
</blockquote>
<h4 data-id="heading-3">场景2：第三方库没提供类型？自己写！</h4>
<p>比如你用了某个小众npm包，叫<code>super-fast-hash</code>，作者没写类型，但你又不想用<code>any</code>（毕竟开了 <code>noImplicitAny</code>）。</p>
<p>你可以：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-ts" lang="ts"><span class="hljs-comment">// types/super-fast-hash.d.ts</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">declare</span> <span class="hljs-variable language_">module</span> <span class="hljs-string">'super-fast-hash'</span> {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> <span class="hljs-attr">hash</span>: <span class="hljs-function">(<span class="hljs-params">input: <span class="hljs-built_in">string</span></span>) =&gt;</span> <span class="hljs-built_in">string</span>;
  <span class="hljs-keyword">export</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">default</span> hash;
}
</code></pre>
<p>然后你就可以：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-ts" lang="ts"><span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> hash <span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> <span class="hljs-string">'super-fast-hash'</span>;
<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> result = <span class="hljs-title function_">hash</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'hello'</span>); <span class="hljs-comment">// 类型正确，不报错</span>
</code></pre>
<blockquote>
<p>虽然这库可能就用一次，但至少代码看起来“专业”了点，对吧？</p>
</blockquote>
<h4 data-id="heading-4">场景3：我想在多个文件里用同一个type，但不想到处import</h4>
<p>比如我们项目里经常用到一种“用户状态”：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-ts" lang="ts"><span class="hljs-keyword">type</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">UserStatus</span> = <span class="hljs-string">'active'</span> | <span class="hljs-string">'inactive'</span> | <span class="hljs-string">'pending'</span>;
</code></pre>
<p>如果每个文件都import，太麻烦。不如：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-ts" lang="ts"><span class="hljs-comment">// types/global-types.d.ts</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">type</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">UserStatus</span> = <span class="hljs-string">'active'</span> | <span class="hljs-string">'inactive'</span> | <span class="hljs-string">'pending'</span>;
</code></pre>
<p>然后在 <code>tsconfig.json</code> 里加：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-json" lang="json"><span class="hljs-punctuation">{</span>
  <span class="hljs-attr">"compilerOptions"</span><span class="hljs-punctuation">:</span> <span class="hljs-punctuation">{</span>
    <span class="hljs-attr">"typeRoots"</span><span class="hljs-punctuation">:</span> <span class="hljs-punctuation">[</span><span class="hljs-string">"node_modules/@types"</span><span class="hljs-punctuation">,</span> <span class="hljs-string">"types"</span><span class="hljs-punctuation">]</span>
  <span class="hljs-punctuation">}</span>
<span class="hljs-punctuation">}</span>
</code></pre>
<p>这样，<strong>所有 <code>.ts</code>文件里都能直接用<code>UserStatus</code>，不用import</strong>。</p>
<blockquote>
<p>是不是有点“全局污染”？是。但小项目图个省事。</p>
</blockquote>
<h3 data-id="heading-5">三、<code>.d.ts</code>文件的潜规则</h3>
<ol>
<li>
<p><strong>文件名无所谓，但最好有意义</strong><br>
比如<code>axios.d.ts</code>、<code>env.d.ts</code>，一看就知道是干啥的。</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>内容只能是类型相关</strong><br>
你不能在<code>.d.ts</code>里写<code>const x = 1</code>，会报错。它只能有<code>type</code>、<code>interface</code>、<code>declare</code> 这些。</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>declare module 是“声明模块”的万能钥匙</strong><br>
第三方库没类型？用它！JS 文件想加类型？用它！</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>别滥用，小心“类型幻觉”</strong><br>
你写了个<code>declare const api: any;</code>，确实不报错了，但等于啥也没做。<strong>类型检查形同虚设</strong>，别骗自己。</p>
</li>
</ol>
<h3 data-id="heading-6">结尾</h3>
<p><code>.d.ts</code>文件用得好，它让你的项目更健壮；用得烂，它让你的类型系统变成“皇帝的新衣”。</p>
<p>（写完这篇，我回头看了看项目里的十几个 <code>.d.ts</code> 文件，叹了口气：是时候重构了……）</p></div></div>
